data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Egidius', meaning 'Earth-born'. This name was borne by several saints, including Saint Egidius of Singidunum and Saint Egidius of Tours. The name Egidius carries the meaning “Earth-born” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Egidius usually hope their child will grow to embody earth-born and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אגידיוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אגידיוס נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'אגיס', שפירושה מגן. הוא קשור לנושא מגן או מגן האל, ומשמש כסמל להגנה אלוהית. השם משמש בקרב הנוצרים וקשור למסורת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Αἰγίδιος
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Αἰγίδιος προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὸ ἑλληνικὸ 'αἰγίς', ποὺ σημαίνει ἀσπίδα. Συνδέεται μὲ τὸν προστάτη ἢ τὸν ἀσπίδα τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ χρησιμοποείται ὡς σύμβολο τῆς θωράκισης ἀπὸ τὸν Θεό. Τὸ ὄνομα εἶναι διαδεδομένο στὴν χριστιανικὴ παράδοση.

in_latin.name: Egidius
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Egidius is derived from the Greek 'aegis', meaning shield. It is associated with a protector or defender, symbolizing divine protection. The name has been used in Christian tradition and is linked to several saints and martyrs.

in_english.name: Egidius
in_english.long_meaning: The name Egidius originates from the Greek 'aegis', meaning shield. It signifies a shield bearer or protector, symbolizing defense and protection. In Christian tradition, Egidius is associated with saints and martyrs, embodying spiritual protection and strength. The name reflects a strong, defensive character.

Today, it remains a relatively obscure name outside the Christian world, but it remains a steady choice for those who value its historical and cultural meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Egidius lies in its association with the saints who bore this name. Saint Egidius of Singidunum is said to have been born in a humble manner, and his life was characterized by profound humility and a strong commitment to serving others. Saint Egidius of Tours is remembered for his miraculous abilities, including healing the sick and providing food to the hungry. These aspects of the lives of the saints Egidius offer inspiration and encouragement to those who bear this name, reminding them to live with humility, compassion, and a strong faith in God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Egidius is derived from the Latin name Aegidius, which means "guardian of the flock." In Christian tradition, St. Egidius is known for his patronage of shepherds and herdsmen, reflecting the spiritual connection between the care of the physical flock and the nurturing of the spiritual flock.
